note: Verbatim field values from Kalshi's public GET /trade-api/v2/markets responses for the precious-metals 15-minute ladders, recorded 2026-09-17 (UTC). Fields the parsers do not read (price_ranges, exchange_index, expected/latest_expiration_time, notional_value_dollars, settlement_value_dollars, previous_* dollars) are trimmed; every value kept is exactly as Kalshi returned it. Note the settlement chain visible in the data: one window's expiration_value is the next window's floor_strike.

markets.title: Gold price up in next 15 mins?
markets.rules_primary: If the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for Gold on Sep 16, 2026 at 7:00 PM EDT is at least the close price of the 1-minute Pyth GOLD candlestick at 6:45 PM EDT on September 16, 2026 USD/|| Unit ||, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The settlement value is rounded to the nearest 2 decimal places. When confirming the settlement value, note the close price for the 1-minute candlestick at a given time is the price at the end of the immediately preceding one-minute interval. For example, the candlestick timestamped 4:59 PM reflects trading during 4:59:00 PM to 4:59:59 PM and closes at 5:00:00 PM. If no data is published by the specified source agency for the specified time, then the most recently available published data will be used to resolve the market.
